lines.ruling: Ruling: finding; f1040s3 p. 1, line 6a, "General business credit. Attach Form 3800"; i1040gi p. 116, Lines 6a Through 6z. As ruled before on this line: line 7 is $0 behind one refusal per situation of lines 6b to 6m and for a credit carried from 2024, and has none for a current-year business credit, which is asked of each business (sc.business_credit) and refuses the business's Schedule C at line 1, and through it Schedule 1 line 3, adjusted gross income and the tax, so the return is refused; line 7 itself shows $0 on that refused return. A credit through a partnership, S corporation, rental or farm is refused whole by scope.schedule1, and a Form 8978 amount (line 6l) by scope.other_line16, held by the coverage row for Form 8986. The mortgage interest credit is asked only when home mortgage interest is entered (owner decision; BUG-0619). No completed return has a wrong value. Recorded in BUG-0620 (6) (open): the line-level refusal for a business credit waits for the next change to Schedule 3.

Ruling: finding; i1040gi p. 117, Line 12, "Enter any credit for federal excise taxes paid on fuels that are ultimately used for a nontaxable purpose (for example, an off-highway business use)". As line 7: a business's claim is asked of each business (sc.fuel_credit) and refuses its Schedule C at line 1, and the return through it; line 12 itself refuses only the claim for kerosene used at home and shows $0 on a return refused for a business's claim. No completed return has a wrong value. Recorded in BUG-0620 (open).

Ruling: finding; f1040s3 p. 1, line 13a, "Form 2439", and line 13c; i1040gi p. 117, Line 13c. As ruled before on this line: a Form 2439 is refused by sd.other_forms on Schedule D, and through it Form 1040 line 7a and the return; a net elective payment election amount belongs to a business credit (sc.business_credit, refused on Schedule C). Line 14 itself refuses only the line 13b, 13d and 13z situations and shows $0 on a return refused for the other two. No completed return has a wrong value. Recorded in BUG-0620 (6) (open): a refusal on line 14 for sd.other_forms needs that question added to the Schedule 3 slice profile, whose fixtures withhold it.
